hooks.command: if command -v dev-charter >/dev/null 2>&1; then dev-charter status --brief --session-start 2>/dev/null; [ $? -eq 2 ] && echo 'The dev-charter command is older than its plugin: run uv tool upgrade dev-charter.' && dev-charter status --brief 2>/dev/null; else echo 'The Dev Charter plugin is installed, but the dev-charter command is not: uv tool install dev-charter'; fi; exit 0
